Before we begin

01 / 05

Brand assets

Please upload your vector brand logos (.SVG or .EPS format) and your high-resolution product photography/assets.

Why we askClean vector files let us place your mark precisely in the film: on product, apparel or equipment, or as a closing signature.

What your files include

or
02 / 05

Atmospheric mood

Select the visual tone that aligns with your winter campaign rollout.

Why we askYour choice sets the lighting, colour grade and pace of the film, with no creative writing needed from your team.

Visual tone

03 / 05

Technical specifications & formats

Where will these assets primarily live?

Why we askFixing the frame on day one means every shot is composed for where it will live, with nothing re-rendered at the end.

Format

04 / 05

Reference links

Drop 1–2 links to your current website, Instagram feed, or past campaigns so our team can match your existing visual identity perfectly.

Good to knowPublic links work best. If a page needs a password, share it with your studio contact.

05 / 05

Sound

Select the sound direction for your film, and share a reference if you have one.

Why we askSound carries much of a film's feeling. Your choice sets the music, pace and texture of the edit.

Sound direction

Good to knowA reference guides direction only. A commercial track needs a licence to appear in the final film. Send any sonic logo or brand music with your assets.
